value.rationale: The fixed-content equality problem at n=8 is explicitly motivated by Problem 10.1 of the 2026 primary source. This completes that first post-exception even-length nontrivial sharp case with a full order-isomorphism classification, gives a uniform exact counting polynomial over every finite ordered alphabet, and exhibits rigid one-versus-three multiplicities for all admissible Parikh profiles. It is a natural equality-case refinement, not a routine increase in a sequence table; no general statement for longer lengths is claimed.
